seed: ask-works-in-an-empty-window-and-makes-the-pictu: Ask with nothing open at Next defaults, no flag touched. In the New window a video request says Ask can't make videos yet and keeps the words; in an empty window the title bar Ask is there and pressed by pointer, a request about something already open says nothing is open yet and keeps the words, and a picture request naming its size (800 x 600) fills that window with an 800 by 600 image and Ask draws into it

steps.text: a video of waves on a beach

steps.note: the empty window became an 800 by 600 picture and Ask drew the lighthouse into it
